PowerShell 7.7.0
PS C:\Users\penelope> $Client = [System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new()
PS C:\Users\penelope> $Client.Connect("127.0.0.1", 28011)
PS C:\Users\penelope> $Stream = $Client.GetStream()
PS C:\Users\penelope>
PS C:\Users\penelope> function Read-Exact {
>>     param([int]$Count)
>>     $b = [byte[]]::new($Count)
>>     $p = 0
>>     while ($p -lt $Count) {
>>         $n = $Stream.Read($b, $p, $Count - $p)
>>         if ($n -le 0) { throw "PINE応答終了" }
>>         $p += $n
>>     }
>>     return ,$b
>> }
PS C:\Users\penelope>
PS C:\Users\penelope> function Read32 {
>>     param([uint32]$Address)
>>
>>     $body = [byte[]]::new(5)
>>     $body[0] = 2
>>     [Array]::Copy([BitConverter]::GetBytes($Address), 0, $body, 1, 4)
>>
>>     $packet = [byte[]]::new(9)
>>     [Array]::Copy([BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]9), 0, $packet, 0, 4)
>>     [Array]::Copy($body, 0, $packet, 4, 5)
>>
>>     $Stream.Write($packet, 0, 9)
>>
>>     $h = Read-Exact 4
>>     $len = [BitConverter]::ToUInt32($h, 0)
>>     $r = Read-Exact ([int]$len - 4)
>>
>>     if ($r[0] -ne 0 -or $r.Length -ne 5) {
>>         throw "PINE Read32失敗"
>>     }
>>
>>     return [BitConverter]::ToUInt32($r, 1)
>> }
PS C:\Users\penelope>
PS C:\Users\penelope> try {
>>     Write-Host "`n===== 味方特技ルート関数テーブル =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
>>
>>     for ($a = [uint32]0x00918C70; $a -lt 0x00919670; $a += 4) {
>>         $v = Read32 $a
>>         if ($v -ne 0) {
>>             "0x{0:X8} : 0x{1:X8}" -f $a, $v
>>         }
>>     }
>>
>>     Write-Host "`n===== 0x002D4400～0x002D4900 =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
>>
>>     for ($a = [uint32]0x002D4400; $a -lt 0x002D4900; $a += 4) {
>>         $v = Read32 $a
>>         "0x{0:X8} : 0x{1:X8}" -f $a, $v
>>     }
>>
>>     Write-Host "`n===== 完了 =====" -ForegroundColor Green
>> }
>> finally {
>>     $Stream.Dispose()
>>     $Client.Dispose()
>> }
